claims.evidence: No brand markings, labels, or screen size reference visible in the dark, cropped photo; only a generic CRT-shaped rear is seen.

claims.claim: The transformer got blown up (implying it is faulty/non-working)
claims.evidence: No power-on test, internal view, or burn marks are visible in the single dark exterior shot; the claim cannot be confirmed or denied from the photo.

risks.risk: Unit may not power on at all (consistent with seller's own claim of a blown transformer)
risks.proof: A video of the TV being plugged in and powered on, or at minimum a photo of the power indicator lit
risks.if_unproven: priced as fully non-working, repair-needed unit

risks.risk: Screen could be cracked, discolored, or have dead picture even if repaired
risks.proof: A well-lit photo of the full front screen and display area
risks.if_unproven: priced as worst-case screen condition (assume cracked/unusable)

risks.risk: Brand/model cannot be confirmed as LG
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the brand label or model sticker on the back/bottom panel
risks.if_unproven: priced as unbranded/generic CRT TV, not LG-specific

risks.risk: Actual screen size may differ from stated 29 inch
risks.proof: Photo with a tape measure across the screen diagonal
risks.if_unproven: priced at the smallest plausible CRT size for this body shape

risks.proof: Photo showing all included accessories laid out next to the unit
risks.if_unproven: priced as bare unit with no accessories

risks.risk: Hidden cosmetic damage (dents, scratches, casing cracks) obscured by poor lighting
risks.proof: Multiple well-lit photos from front, back, and both sides

risks.risk: Internal damage beyond the transformer (e.g., burnt board, capacitor damage) given seller's own admission of electrical failure
risks.proof: Photo or video of the internal board showing extent of damage

proof_requests: Photo of the brand/model label on the rear or bottom of the unit
Well-lit photos of the front screen from multiple angles
Video attempting to power on the unit, showing any response (lights, sound, picture)
Photo with a tape measure showing the screen's diagonal size
Photo of any included accessories (remote, cables, stand)
Close-up photo or video of the internal damage near the transformer, if accessible
response.reason: The witness confirms this is a CRT-type television, so it can be priced at worst case as a non-working, unbranded, accessory-less unit consistent with the seller's own claim of electrical failure, pending the listed proofs to raise value.
